title: Jev-as-a-Judge for RAG Claim Verification: Confidence-Gated Cascading Between a Non-Generative Verifier and a Frontier LLM
abstract: arXiv:2610.20634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation asks one question at volume: does this evidence support this claim? The answer is one bit, yet most pipelines obtain it from a text generator and pay generation prices for the prose wrapped around it. We compare a non-generative decision model, which returns a typed value from a declared enumeration together with a native probability and no text, against a frontier LLM configured as an engineer would deploy it for binary classification. Both answer the same 495 human-labelled claims from LLM-AggreFact, so every comparison is within-item. We report three things. First, the two systems are statistically indistinguishable on the metric this task is conventionally scored by, a paired difference of -0.56 points, Jev minus Astra, at a 187-fold cost difference. translated_title: 用于RAG声明验证的Jev-as-a-Judge：非生成式验证器与前沿大语言模型之间的置信度门控级联
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中有一个被大量反复提出的问题：这条证据是否支持该声明？答案只是一个比特，但大多数流程却通过文本生成器来获取它，并为其外层包裹的文字支付生成成本。我们将一个非生成式决策模型——它从预定义的枚举中返回一个类型化值，附带原生概率且不产生任何文本——与一个按工程师实际部署方式配置用于二分类任务的前沿大语言模型进行对比。两者对来自LLM-AggreFact的相同的495条人工标注声明作答，因此每一项比较都是同项目内的配对比较。我们报告三点发现：第一，在该任务通常的评分指标上，两个系统在统计上无法区分，配对差异为-0.56个百分点（Jev减Astra），而成本相差187倍；第二，这种平局几乎不携带任何关于部署的信息：两个系统在15.2%的声明上存在分歧，而较便宜的系统接受了其中23.2%的声明……
tldr: 该论文提出用置信度门控级联将非生成式验证器与前沿LLM结合用于RAG声明验证，发现两者准确率在统计上无差异但成本相差187倍，从而论证可通过级联策略在保证判定质量的同时大幅降低验证成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes confidence-gated cascading between a non-generative verifier and a frontier LLM for RAG claim verification, showing the two are statistically indistinguishable in accuracy despite a 187-fold cost difference, and argues that such cascading can drastically cut verification costs without sacrificing judgment quality.
